messages.subject: HowTo MaxQtoMSstatsFormat and fractionation
parts:
Hello,

I believe it's a very basic/stupid question I have here but I couldn't figure it out.

I try to convert my files using MaxQtoMSstatsFormat but I obtain a quant file with 0 entries.
I believe I'm making an error generating my annotation file but can't figure out how to fix it.

I took a small example for trying where I have one individual (M05-02) and 3 different time points (V1,V2,V3). Each time point is composed of 8 fractions (8 raw files).
I tried with that table (and couple of other combination) but it doesn't work. How should I build the annotation file for it to take the fractionation into account??



Thanks a lot for your help!!

Best,
Ben

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: HowTo MaxQtoMSstatsFormat and fractionation
parts:
Hi Ben,

You can add 'Fraction' column. I guess that the values should be E1, E2, ..., E8 for your experiment.

Also, IsotopeLabelType column should be L or light or H or heavy.

After you fix and still it doesn't work, please send me the dataset privately. I will check and delete it.

HTH.

- Meena

--> Yes, IsotopeLabelType column needs 'L'
Also, just to make sure, what should I fill in the Experiment column?? To what does that column correspond? I'm not entirely sure there.
--> It should be the combination of Condition and BioReplicate. It should not include Fraction information.

Also, I don't know if it's a result of a bad writing of the annotation file but when I run the dataprocess command (the one recommended for MaxQuant as it's the tool I use), I see a message saying that 4500 transitions are completely missing in one condition.
Does it mean in at least one of the condition? That would make more sense to me than saying that 1 condition in particular is completely missing 4500 proteins.
--> Yes, it means that those transitions are completely missing in one condition.
Finally, it could not generate the summarization per subplot. Is it due to the data or can it be something else??

--> From the progress, it seemed to work. The message said that two proteins can't summarize. But others can. Processed$RunlevelData should have summarization.

HTH
- Meena
